title: #253: How Runway Is Transforming Creative Work With AI Agents
description:
Runway's small creative team couldn't keep up with paid ad demand. Producing 77 ad units a week meant pulling people off brand, research, and product work. So they built an AI agent to handle the versioning, and now produce roughly 900 ads a week with return on ad spend doubled.
Mike Kaput talks with Jamie Umpherson, Runway's Chief Creative Officer, about how that agent became Runway Ads, how App Studio turns vibe coding into custom creative software, and why taste and point of view matter more than ever for creatives working with AI.
Part of the AI Transformations series.
